headline: SURFACE LAPTOP ULTRA
subheadline: The most powerful Surface laptop ever built, engineered for the frontier of local AI and 3D graphics. Powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip.
proof_near_the_promise: Trade-in offer: up to $1,000 cash back on a MacBook Pro
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The hero is a product launch. Copilot, Microsoft 365, Azure, and Teams are separate bands further down, each with its own Learn more.
pain_point: Devices are not powerful enough for local AI, and business buyers still need AI inside the apps they already use.
solution: A flagship laptop for local AI, plus Copilot inside Microsoft 365 and Azure for the business.
ux_notes: Retail homepage, not a single brand promise. A chat prompt sits in the personal and business sections. The business band says AI built for work and points to Azure as limitless innovation.

headline: The future of building happens together
subheadline: Tools and trends evolve, but collaboration endures. With GitHub, developers, agents, and code come together on one platform.
proof_near_the_promise: Duolingo boosts developer speed by 25% with GitHub Copilot; Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Code Assistants
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Feature rows under the hero (Copilot, Actions, Advanced Security, Projects) plus customer stories. Security promise is delivered as Autofix, Dependabot, and secret protection.
pain_point: Code, agents, and people are split across tools, and security fixes steal time from building.
solution: One platform where developers and agents write, ship, and fix code together.
ux_notes: Classic product homepage: one promise, a product demo animation, then feature chapters. Primary action is downloading Copilot, not contacting sales.

headline: Tools that work for you.
subheadline: Bring any idea to life with products for creators, businesses, and beyond.
proof_near_the_promise: Students and teachers save 71%
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Product lanes on the same page: Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere, Acrobat, and Adobe for Business, each with its own explore link. Customer quotes sit beside the plans.
pain_point: Creating and finishing work takes too many tools and too much time.
solution: A suite that creates, generates, and handles documents, with Firefly as the generative layer.
ux_notes: The page is a mosaic of product promises rather than one campaign. Free trial is repeated as the conversion. US Google traffic is the largest in this set.

headline: From startups to enterprises, AWS is how leaders have powered innovation for 20 years
subheadline: Join the largest global community of innovators who trust AWS to accelerate transformation and redefine industries.
primary_cta: I want to try AWS for free
secondary_cta: I want to see new customer stories
proof_near_the_promise: 124 Availability Zones in 39 regions
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The hero states the leadership claim. Industry stories and the infrastructure map deliver the proof. The free tier is a conversational prompt, not a form on the hero.
pain_point: Innovation stalls because infrastructure is hard to scale.
solution: The default cloud for builders, entered through a free trial.
ux_notes: Highest engagement in the hosting ranking: almost 10 minutes and 12.7 pages, with a 28% bounce. The CTA is phrased as a visitor intent inside a guide, which is a distinct UX from a button.

headline: Ship AI agents faster in Microsoft Foundry
subheadline: Model and harness choice, complete with continuous optimization.
proof_near_the_promise: Ignite registration banner, Nov 17-20, 2026
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Solution cards immediately under the hero: agentic tools, Azure AI, databases, analytics, migration. Customer stories follow.
pain_point: Teams cannot get AI agents from experiment to production without losing choice or control.
solution: Microsoft Foundry as the place to ship agents, on Azure's infrastructure.
ux_notes: Engagement figures are Similarweb's for azure.com. Very low bounce and deep visits. An AI assistant offers to find a product. Event registration sits above the product hero.

headline: The new way to cloud
subheadline: Build with AI. Deploy and scale apps fast. Analyze and secure your data. Start now with $300 in free credit.
proof_near_the_promise: $300 welcome credit; 20+ products on a free tier; up to $350,000 in startup credits
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The credit is the promise and the offer in the same line. Product groups below cover agents, Gemini, compute, data, and security.
pain_point: Starting on a new cloud is expensive and slow, and AI workloads need a place to run.
solution: A developer cloud you can try with credits, built around Gemini and managed AI.
ux_notes: A secondary line, Outpace adversaries in the AI era, is the only fear accent. The commercial engine is the credit, repeated for developers, AI builders, and startups. Strong engagement: 7 minutes, 8.9 pages.

headline: Get started with the #1 AI CRM
subheadline: Your agents, your team, and your data — working together so every customer interaction reflects your business at its best.
proof_near_the_promise: 34% increase in employee productivity, from the 2026 Salesforce Success Metrics
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The marquee states the claim. AIforce, Agentforce, Customer 360, and Data 360 modules explain how. Stories show agents in jewelry, sports, and education.
pain_point: Customer data, apps, and AI agents do not work as one system.
solution: The #1 AI CRM, where humans and agents share the same data and rules.
ux_notes: Low bounce for a large software site. Dual CTA is the enterprise pattern: free start for small business, demo for everyone else. The page is organized as a platform map, not a feature list.

headline: Modernize critical software
subheadline: For developers building the future, discover how agentic AI helps modernize mission-critical software without sacrificing security, control or flexibility.
proof_near_the_promise: APIS IT: 100% refactored code with IBM Bob. HR costs cut 40% with watsonx Orchestrate.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Product cards under the hero each carry a customer result: Bob, watsonx, Confluent, FlashSystem, Vault, Maximo. Consulting is a later band.
pain_point: Mission-critical software is old, and AI projects do not show a business result.
solution: Agentic tools that modernize code and run agents, sold with a measured outcome on each card.
ux_notes: Long visits and many pages. The hero is for developers; the rest of the page is a catalog of products, each reduced to one proof number. TechXchange event sits above the hero.

headline: Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost.
subheadline: That's why so many of the world's biggest technology companies use OCI.
proof_near_the_promise: Named OCI customers include AMD, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Uber, and xAI. 1.2 billion watt Texas data center and 500,000 NVIDIA GPUs.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The first block is Oracle AI World (Register now). The cloud claim is the next section, then multicloud database, AI Data Platform, and Fusion apps.
pain_point: AI cloud capacity is scarce and expensive, and enterprise data is stuck in one cloud.
solution: High-performance OCI, plus the same database in AWS, Google, Azure, and Oracle data centers.
ux_notes: No single campaign headline. The page stacks an event, a cost claim, a capacity claim, and an applications claim. Price parity across clouds is the distinctive offer.

headline: Everything we learned from powering 20% of the Internet—yours by default
subheadline: One platform for your apps, agents, and workforce. Build, secure, and scale without managing infrastructure.
proof_near_the_promise: 45% of the Fortune 500. 335+ cities. Within 50ms of 95% of the world's population. Shopify quote on simplicity.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The hero states the platform. A comparison (fighting infra vs shipping on Cloudflare) and public prices ($0, $20, $200, custom) deliver it.
pain_point: Infrastructure, security, and performance are separate bills and separate systems.
solution: One network that runs code, security, and connectivity, with a free plan.
ux_notes: Self-serve conversion: price is on the homepage. The headline borrows authority from scale, then hands it to the visitor. Connect 2026 is a top banner, not the hero.

headline: A New Beginning for Windows PCs
subheadline: NVIDIA RTX Spark brings NVIDIA AI and RTX graphics together in one powerful PC for creating, developing, and gaming. Preorder now.
proof_near_the_promise: Page title: World Leader in AI Computing. CoreWeave running production agentic workloads on Vera Rubin at 4.8x token throughput.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: A carousel: PCs, GTC registration, data-center ROI, a CEO keynote, and an agent-safety platform. Each slide has its own link.
pain_point: AI needs infrastructure that earns a return, and PCs need local AI plus graphics.
solution: NVIDIA as the computing layer for AI, from the PC to the data center.
ux_notes: The H1 is a brand label, Artificial Intelligence Computing Leadership. The live slide is a product. Registration for GTC is as prominent as any product CTA. Little paid search.

headline: Save up to $500. Deals and award-winning picks.
subheadline: Shop PCMag's Best Consumer Laptop, XPS 13, plus earn 2X back in Dell Rewards.
proof_near_the_promise: A second band with Microsoft and NVIDIA: Built for the AI Agent Era.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Deals and product tiles (XPS, monitors, PowerEdge) are the conversion. Servers add Contact us beside Shop servers. Dell Premier is the IT-buyer path.
pain_point: Buyers want a current deal, and IT buyers want one place to purchase.
solution: A store: promotions up front, an AI-PC story beside it, and a business hub lower down.
ux_notes: The H1 is a category label and the first interaction is a chat: How can I help you today? Ask me about today's best deals. Paid search is meaningful. Conversion is Add to cart, not a demo.

headline: A New Vision for AI
subheadline: At Innovation World 2026, Lenovo unveils groundbreaking technology that embodies its vision of Smarter AI for all.
proof_near_the_promise: Named a leader in the 2026 ISG AI-Ready Infrastructure Solutions report. Lenovo Pro: extra $100 off the first $1,000.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The AI vision is a campaign. The commercial path is Lenovo Pro for business and weekly deals. Copilot+ PCs are a product band.
pain_point: Businesses need AI across devices, infrastructure, and services, and a reason to buy from Lenovo rather than a retailer.
solution: Smarter AI for all, sold through a business store and Copilot+ PCs.
ux_notes: Several headlines compete: the event, Lenovo Pro, and Smarter AI for what's next. The business CTA is Sign up now, with a discount.

headline: Evolve your approach to cyber defense in the AI era.
subheadline: Realize the potential of agentic AI for collaboration and customer experience. Four days, 150-plus sessions, thousands of experts.
proof_near_the_promise: Trusted by 99% of the Fortune 500 and over 1 million customers. 39M networking devices. 750B+ security events observed daily.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The top line is a security guide. The hero is the WebexOne event. Platform modules (Cloud Control, AI Canvas, Silicon One, Hybrid Mesh Firewall) deliver the product promise underneath.
pain_point: Security and networking were built for an earlier era, and AI workloads need both speed and control.
solution: One vendor for AI-ready networking, security, and collaboration, with humans still governing policy.
ux_notes: The homepage is an event plus a guidance banner. The durable promise, market-defining technologies driving the future of AI, is below the fold. An Ask Cisco chat is the last prompt.

headline: An effortless way to Googlebook
subheadline: Discover the Googlebook built on a trusted Intel platform—performance, graphics, battery, and connectivity engineered to work as one.
proof_near_the_promise: Page title: Intel Inside - Built for AI.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: A product carousel: a Googlebook, Xeon 6+ for AI networking, Arc handheld graphics, and a McLaren partnership. Each slide is its own product.
pain_point: Buyers need a reason to believe the chip, not the brand of the laptop.
solution: Intel as the trusted platform inside AI PCs, networks, and handhelds.
ux_notes: No company-level offer. Highest bounce in the hardware group. The page behaves like a campaign rotator. No paid-search estimate in the US pull.

headline: Discover the power of knowing
subheadline: Give your teams the shared context they need to make smarter decisions, coordinate seamlessly, and ship with confidence.
proof_near_the_promise: 44% better answer quality and 48% fewer tokens in an internal study. 350,000+ teams.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Teamwork Graph and the Teamwork Collection (Jira, Confluence, Loom, Rovo) explain the mechanism. Customer stories quantify hours saved.
pain_point: Work context is scattered, so people and agents make worse decisions.
solution: A teamwork platform that gives humans and agents the same context.
ux_notes: Short visits but a low bounce and a paid-search presence. The headline is abstract; the subheadline does the explaining. Dual CTA splits self-serve and sales.

headline: Your life's work, powered by our life's work
subheadline: A unique and powerful software suite to transform the way you work. Designed for businesses of all sizes, built by a company that values your privacy.
proof_near_the_promise: Mercedes-Benz India quote. Featured apps: CRM, Mail, Creator, Books, Desk.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: App grid and Zoho One (50+ apps) deliver the suite. Zia Agent Studio delivers the agent promise. A privacy claim is in the subheadline itself.
pain_point: Businesses are assembled from too many apps, and they do not want to trade privacy for software.
solution: One suite, including an agent builder, with a free start.
ux_notes: The strongest engagement in the developer-software ranking: almost 13 minutes, 11 pages, 28% bounce. The tone is craft and privacy, not AI hype, with agents as a second chapter.

headline: What are Design and Make leaders doing differently?
subheadline: Discover what 5,500 industry leaders reveal about turning AI, digital transformation, and sustainability into business advantage.
proof_near_the_promise: Autodesk 2027 State of Design & Make Report
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The homepage conversion is the report. Products are a secondary path. Industry navigation sits under the report.
pain_point: Leaders need to know what peers are doing with AI and sustainability before they buy tools.
solution: A research gate, with the product catalog behind it.
ux_notes: Unusual for this set: the homepage sells insight, not a trial. Low bounce and solid page depth suggest the report holds visitors. Paid search is present.

headline: Your idea, online. Made easy.
subheadline: An agentic platform to build, run, and grow your business online, all in one place.
proof_near_the_promise: 30-day money-back guarantee. Free domain for a year on yearly plans. 85% of issues solved without a human.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The agent is demonstrated in the next section: describe the site, get a plan in under a minute, no signup. Pricing plans follow.
pain_point: Getting online still feels technical, and support is slow.
solution: An agent that builds and runs the site, bundled with hosting.
ux_notes: Global engagement is excellent even though US Google traffic is smaller than the enterprise clouds. Paid-search ETV is high relative to organic traffic, which fits a self-serve checkout. Price and guarantee are on the page.

headline: Automate up to 80% of interactions with Zendesk AI agents.
subheadline: Built to improve with every resolution. Proven across 4.8B+ resolutions.
proof_near_the_promise: 22,000+ service teams. 830M AI interactions. 4.8B resolutions. Gartner Magic Quadrant leader for the CRM Customer Engagement Center.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The 80% claim is the hero. Platform sections and a pricing calculator deliver it. A closing band repeats Try for free and Get a demo.
pain_point: Support volume grows faster than headcount, and chatbots only deflect.
solution: AI agents that resolve issues end to end and learn from each resolution.
ux_notes: The H1 is a category label, AI-powered customer service platform. The promise is the line under it. Heavy organic traffic plus one of the larger paid-search budgets in the set. Replaces GoDaddy, whose homepage returned 403 on every fetch.

headline: Fortinet delivers cybersecurity everywhere you need it.
subheadline: We secure the entire digital attack surface from devices, data, and apps and from data center to home office.
proof_near_the_promise: First on-page headline is a 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant leader placement for Hybrid Mesh Firewall.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The promise lives in the title, the description, and the header demo button. The page body is news, threat reports, and event registration.
pain_point: The attack surface is spread across devices, data, apps, and locations.
solution: One security fabric, entered through a product demo.
ux_notes: Long visits for a security site. The live page does not have a designed hero; it leads with awards and a line that AI is accelerating attacks. Fear shows up in the reports, not in a scare headline.

headline: Ask. Remediate. Optimize.
subheadline: Meet the next-generation, AI-driven observability platform.
proof_near_the_promise: Then a split: 78% AI usage growth and 94% of enterprises using gen AI, against +56% exploited zero-days, +73% ransomware, +56% breaches. 90% MTTR reduction. Up to 30.9B inline attacks blocked a day.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The top module is a product (Cortex). The company argument is the good-news/bad-news block, resolved by platformization and Precision AI. Analyst badges follow.
pain_point: Attackers are faster, and a pile of security tools cannot keep up with AI adoption.
solution: One platform that uses AI to see, block, and respond.
ux_notes: The clearest enterprise fear frame in the set: threat statistics are on the homepage, then the product is the relief. Bounce is the highest among the enterprise security homepages here.

headline: One unified platform to secure the agentic enterprise
subheadline: The Falcon platform combines the world's richest security data, AI intelligence, automation, and elite expertise to stop breaches. Collect once and use everywhere.
proof_near_the_promise: Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Endpoint Protection, and in Forrester and IDC assessments.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Platform modules (AI, cloud, identity, SOC, adversary intelligence) and a free trial with no credit card. Pricing is shown as bundles.
pain_point: Breaches, and a stack of tools that do not share data, including tools that now have to cover AI agents.
solution: One data platform that stops breaches and covers the agentic enterprise.
ux_notes: The title is We stop breaches, which names the bad outcome without listing scare statistics. The page sells a platform, a trial, and analyst proof. Paid search is active.

headline: Welcome to the secure agentic future
subheadline: Missed the livestream? Catch up on the new Blueprint Alliance and our latest product innovations.
proof_near_the_promise: Slide 2: Okta secures AI. Slide 3: Future-proof your identity stack. Nav also offers Contact us.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The first slide delivers an event. The product promise is the next slides: agents under the same identity platform as employees and customers. Free trial is persistent in the nav.
pain_point: AI agents are a new identity that current access tools do not govern.
solution: One identity platform for employees, customers, and agents.
ux_notes: A carousel hides the product headline behind an event recap. The commercial CTAs (Free trial, Contact us, Get started) stay available. Large organic search traffic and no measured paid clicks in this pull.

headline: Protection you don't have to think about
subheadline: Choose a plan that keeps you protected from scams and other threats, we'll look after the rest.
proof_near_the_promise: Around 30% of phishing emails are opened. More than 130 million Americans have been affected by cybercrime. 100% Virus Protection Promise.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Plan cards with first-year prices deliver the promise: device count, scam protection, VPN, dark-web monitoring, LifeLock. A Help me choose quiz sits above the grid.
pain_point: Scams and threats the buyer cannot see, and the effort of staying protected.
solution: One plan that watches scams, devices, and identity.
ux_notes: Ease is the headline. Fear is the evidence underneath, timed to Cybersecurity Awareness Month. Conversion is a priced plan, with Get Deluxe on the popular tier. Deep enough to reach 5.7 pages.

headline: Safe is one thing. Safer is everything.
subheadline: Safe was only antivirus. Safer is one McAfee for scams, data protection, and secure connections.
proof_near_the_promise: Scams cost 1 in 3 Americans an average of $1,160. 5.6 billion AI threat scans a day. 15,000 new scam sites a day. 3,322 data breaches last year. Up to $2M identity coverage.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: The argument is a sequence: a reframe, a loss statistic, then what the product does (spots it, explains it, handles it). Plan cards with coverage limits close the sale. Press quotes from CNET and Tom's Guide follow.
pain_point: Antivirus is no longer enough, and scams plus data exposure are costing people money.
solution: One subscription for scam detection, VPN, identity, and recovery.
ux_notes: The only homepage in the set that leads the argument with loss numbers. The headline is a reframe, but the selling is the $1,160 and the breach count. Short visits, about 1:47.

headline: Cybersecurity that's always a step ahead
subheadline: Keep your internet use safe and private and your devices running smoothly with one of our award-winning, easy-to-use security plans.
proof_near_the_promise: 93 first-place awards in 100 tests. 5.3 billion cyberattacks detected. 500,000 malicious files a day. 27% of users faced web threats.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Award counts and threat volume sit between the hero and the plan ladder: Standard, Plus, Premium. A 30-day money-back guarantee is on the plans.
pain_point: Threats move faster than the user, and protection should not slow the device.
solution: Tiered plans from antivirus to total security, including VPN and identity.
ux_notes: The headline is capability and ease. Threat volume is used as proof, not as the opening scare. Existing customers get Renew now beside the new-buyer path. Low bounce for the category.

headline: Bitdefender is a Global Leader in Cybersecurity
subheadline: Protecting millions of consumer and business environments since 2001.
proof_near_the_promise: Ferrari partnership. 2026 Cybersecurity Assessment Report from 1,200 IT and security professionals.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Three doors under the hero: consumer, small business, enterprise. The bottom of the page splits Try it first, Book a briefing, and Join our network.
pain_point: Different buyers need different security, and a single scare message does not fit all three.
solution: A leader brand with a path for home, small business, and enterprise.
ux_notes: Authority headline, then audience routing. No threat statistics in the hero. Business conversion is Book a briefing; consumer conversion is Try it first.

headline: Build demand, win deals, and delight customers — all on one platform
subheadline: HubSpot aligns marketing, sales, and service around your customer data, so your teams and AI always know what customers need.
proof_near_the_promise: Eyebrow: HubSpot Agentic Customer Platform. Trusted by 306,000+ customers.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Hubs (Marketing, Sales, Service, Content, Data, Revenue, CRM, Agents) are the delivery. A later line names the pain: disconnected tools and data slow you down.
pain_point: Marketing, sales, and service do not share customer data, so AI and teams guess.
solution: One customer platform, with a free start and a demo for the paid suite.
ux_notes: The largest paid-search estimate in the set, which matches a demo-led conversion. The headline is three outcomes. The free CRM is the secondary door, including in the nav.

headline: AI without workflows is just expensive advice
subheadline: Most companies have AI. Few have the data to ground it, the workflows to deploy it, and the security to govern it. ServiceNow is the only platform built for all of it, so AI doesn't just think. It acts.
proof_near_the_promise: 85% of the Fortune 500. 98% renewal rate. 95 billion workflows.
where_the_promise_is_delivered: Control Tower, Flow, and Otto (the assistant) show the mechanism: sense data, decide with context, act across workflows, secure the action. Customer metrics follow.
pain_point: Companies bought AI and got advice, not work.
solution: A workflow platform that lets AI act inside governed business processes.
ux_notes: Problem-first, but the problem is wasted spend, not an attacker. Two CTAs: a product entry and a demo. The promise is restated as a control tower and as an assistant that handles the request end to end.
